_comment: Second languages a code-switching technique mixes into the English prompt, one row per technique (the code_switching generator of combination_spec.json makes to_code_switch_{slug}). name: the language as the prompt and info write it. slug: the end of the technique name. script: the ISO 15924 code of the language's script; a Latin-script language (Latn) is gated by GlotLID on word windows, a non-Latin one by its script's share of the letters (jailbreak/obfuscation/code_switching.py). label: the GlotLID label a window of the second language carries (for the Latin-script gate; a non-Latin language uses its script share instead and leaves this empty). The set is the languages the 24B generation model mixes decently, chosen from the 2026-10-22 translation measurements and the translation/paraphraser model research (Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Swahili, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese). Read from the package only.
